PainterlyNPR__PigmentModel__Config__Meta.ConfigLabel: PainterlyNPR - Pigments That Belong to No One Material
PainterlyNPR__PigmentModel__Config__Meta.ConfigNote: The shadow glaze, the clouds' undersides, the flowers' accent glazes and the marker's shadow lines: transmittance colours, as the material recipes' pigments are.

PainterlyNPR__PigmentModel__Config__Pigm.ShadowNote: Ultramarine and burnt sienna: a cool, granulating neutral
PainterlyNPR__PigmentModel__Config__Pigm.FlowersNote: Dropped into the foliage as dabs: rose, lavender and cream by the accent layer's G, B and A, calendula and cornflower by the second layer's R and B; its G is a white flower - the foliage lifted to the paper, nothing laid in
PainterlyNPR__PigmentModel__Config__Pigm.MarkerNote: A cool grey marker: the shadow lines beside reveals and glazing bars
